text_block_list.text: ――That weekend.

Thank you for coming with me today! 
So now, let's, uh,
let's go where you want to go first!
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
Affrimative. 
Target destination:『there』.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text: 『Training Care』. This is "JYVE".
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
(Uni-san is so focused on that book... 
Is she interested in getting it?)
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
(All right. I just need to buy it for her,
and... 
Wait, what? Where did she――)
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
『Sorry for the delay』, Zenno Rob Roy. 
Here. "GIVU".
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
F-for me...!? 
Th-thank you very much...
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
――! 
Zenno Rob Roy, "stand by" here.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
(Does she need to use the restroom? ――Oh!
I can take this 
chance to find a café she would like...)
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text: ――"Reentry" complete.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text: Uni-san! Would you like to go to a café――
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text: Is this "resupply"... 『unnecessary』?
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text: Not at all! Thank you..!
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Not only am I not returning the favor,
she's doing even 
more for me...!)
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text: (But, I have to do at least one thing in return...! There has to be something or someplace she would like... ――I've got it!)
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
――Uni-san! 
Would you like to watch a movie!?
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
The "panorama" of the space flight...
was 『fascinating』.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
It's a film I've wanted to recommend you
for a long time now! 
So, um... did you enjoy it?
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. 
Zenno Rob Roy's "recommendations" are
『favorites』.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
(Thank goodness... 
It may not have been by much,
but I managed to return a bit of 
her kindness...)
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming along with me today.
I had a wonderful 
time. I hope,
um... I hope it was enjoyable for you too,
Uni-san.
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
"ENJI". 
『Fun』was had. 
Will Zenno Rob Roy 『train』again tomorrow?
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
Y-yes!
Kris S-san and Taiki-san have been helping
me train 
recently.
We'll be right back to it tomorrow――
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text: Neo Universe will provide『help』.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text: What? No, please, you don't need to! I'd feel guilty if you did! You're already doing so, so much for my sake...!
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth,
I invited you out so I could return all
the 
favors you've done for me... 
...I hoped I could, at least.
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
But ultimately I couldn't do much... 
That's why I can't take advantage of your
kindness any longer!
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
So, please,
you don't need to worry about me. 
Anyway, well,
um... Thank you. I'll see you at school.
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
That was... "rejection"? 
"Failure to launch"... "Termination"...?
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
Root cause analysis...
"Aid" provided "matched" correctly with 
"needs".
Zenno Rob Roy's response was 『Thank you』.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
Then... What caused the negative result? 
Cause of "ABSS"..."Analysis" impossible.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
Is it because『Neo Universe is an
alien』...?
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text: Tcennoc.
text_block_list.name: Little Universe

text_block_list.text: Shee...nock? Uhh.... "Knock", like in baseball? Wait, no, I need to account for what "shee" means... Hmm...
text_block_list.name: Universe's Father

text_block_list.text: Tcennoc.
text_block_list.name: Elementary School Un...

text_block_list.text: Uhh... Whaaat? What's that mean? Guuyys, let's go play hide and seeeek!
text_block_list.name: Elementary School Cl...

text_block_list.text: Tcennoc.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text: Uhhh... You sure are doing well today, huh? ...Sorry, I don't quite understand what you mean by "Sheenock", but... Good luck with your training.
text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher

text_block_list.text:
"CUTT"... "Connection" impossible.
"Communication" impossible. 
――Because『Neo Universe is an alien』.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
Potentially "FTL". 
"Communication" with the universe...
The book of the cosmos... 
These provided "comfort".
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text: To everyone else, it was "the dark side of the moon"―― A world, a [*universe*] for Neo Universe alone. Neo Universe's 『home』――
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
E-excuse me...! 
You're Neo Universe-senpai, aren't you...?

Ah... S-sorry to bother you...! 
So, this book... It's about space, right?
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
I noticed you often check out books on the
topic, and, well... 
I've had space on my mind ever since.
This book caught my eye, 
so I couldn't help but call out――
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
―― 『Earth-Alpha』. Like "Gliese",
a "TERY" of a planet. 
"Existence" is unproven, yet "Apollo"――
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
...Negative.
"Communication" is impossible.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
Glie... Apollo... Umm,
are these space terms? 
――Oh,
Earth-Alpha...
I think I know what that means!
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
――! 
"TIPS"... Signal slightly "received"?
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
I've heard about Earth-Alpha!
It's the theory that, outside our galaxy,
there's a solar system similar to our sun's,
like a parallel 
universe...!
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
The idea of another Earth was widely derided
as delusional, 
but there are so many stories out there
dreaming of such a 
fantastical world!
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
So you mean this book has to do with
Earth-Alpha!? 
――Oh... S-sorry,
I got caught up in my excitement!
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
........E-err... Only if you're willing to,
of course, but... 
――Would you recommend some books for me to
read?
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
You're incredible, Uni-san!
You're so much more knowledgeable 
than I am.
And every book you recommend is incredible,
too.
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
The world must shine so beautifully,
seen through your eyes... 
...You have a truly special point of view.
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
――I'd like to see the very same sights as you,
someday.
text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy brought 『happiness』into the
"Alphard" 
[*world*].
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
Wishing to "observe" the "same" sky. 
Bringing『happiness』. 
That's why we are "ZEER"...
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
"Interaction" through language is
impossible. 
However,
"hypothesis"――『standing by her』is
realizable.
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text:
...Hypothesis rejected. 
Unable to "GIVU" smoothly. 
Realization, infeasible...?
text_block_list.name: Neo Universe

text_block_list.text: ――Universe?
text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki

text_block_list.text:
.....You've got a sad look on your face.
What's got you down?
text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
